# Data preparation

## install packages

```{r}
install.packages("tidyverse")
install.packages("psych")
install.packages("tidyr")
install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("ggplot2")
install.packages("ggalluvial")
install.packages("flextable")
install.packages("officer")
```

## loading packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(psych)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggalluvial)
library(flextable)
library(dplyr)
library(officer)
```

## loading data

```{r}
dat <- read_csv2("../Data/z-prosoData_VHUNZIKER_v2.csv")

```

## selecting variables

```{r}
dat <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(K7_21:K7_Opti, #Well-being
                K8_21:K8_Opti,
                K9_21:K9_Opti,
                K7_651:K7_659, #internalizing symptoms Items but not all the Items available that were used for Anxdep Score
                K8_653:K8_659,
                K9_652:K9_656, K9_658:K9_659,
                K7_nSBQ_ANXDEP, K8_nSBQ_ANXDEP, K9_nSBQ_ANXDEP, # Score Anxdep
                K7_402:K7_ResilFriends, # Peer Support
                K7_1101:K7_1105, K7_BullVict4, #Bullying Victimization
                K5_102, K9_102, K9_102o,ADR_GenderChild,  # sex
                K7_5000, K8_5000, K9_5000, # sexual attraction
                'K5#6_ISEImax' #SES
                )
```

### create personal ID

```{r}
# create personal-ID
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(person_id = row_number()) %>%
  relocate(person_id, .before = 1)

# Check if it has worked or any one is doubled
nrow(dat)
n_distinct(dat$person_id)
anyDuplicated(dat$person_id)

```

# Missing values

```{r}
# all Values (-1,9,90,99) should be treated as NA except for person_id and the value 90 in the variable SES
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(across(
    -c(person_id, `K5#6_ISEImax`),
    ~ replace(., . %in% c(-1, 9, 90, 99), NA)
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    `K5#6_ISEImax` = replace(
      `K5#6_ISEImax`,
      `K5#6_ISEImax` %in% c(-1, 9, 99), NA)
  )
```

# Missingness

```{r}
# Missingness of analysis variables 
missing_table <- tibble(
  construct = c(
    "Well-being", "Well-being", "Well-being",
    "Internalizing", "Internalizing", "Internalizing",
    "Sexual orientation", "Sexual orientation", "Sexual orientation",
    "Peer support",
    "Bullying victimization", "Bullying victimization",
    "Gender",
    "SES"
  ),

  wave = c(
    "K7", "K8", "K9",
    "K7", "K8", "K9",
    "K7", "K8", "K9",
    "K7",
    "K7", "K8",
    "Baseline",
    "K5/6"
  ),

  variable = c(
    "K7_Opti", "K8_Opti", "K9_Opti",
    "K7_nSBQ_ANXDEP", "K8_nSBQ_ANXDEP", "K9_nSBQ_ANXDEP",
    "K7_5000", "K8_5000", "K9_5000",
    "K7_ResilFriends",
    "K7_BullVict4", "K8_BullVict4",
    "ADR_GenderChild",
    "K5#6_ISEImax"
  )
) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    N_total = nrow(dat),
    N_available = sum(!is.na(dat[[variable]])),
    N_missing = sum(is.na(dat[[variable]])),
    Percent_missing = round(N_missing / N_total * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

missing_table


# Longitudinal missingness pattern: Well-being
wb_missing_patterns <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    K7 = if_else(is.na(K7_Opti), "Missing", "Available"),
    K8 = if_else(is.na(K8_Opti), "Missing", "Available"),
    K9 = if_else(is.na(K9_Opti), "Missing", "Available")
  ) %>%
  count(K7, K8, K9) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

wb_missing_patterns

# Missings of internalizing over the three waves 
int_missing_patterns <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    K7 = if_else(is.na(K7_nSBQ_ANXDEP), "Missing", "Available"),
    K8 = if_else(is.na(K8_nSBQ_ANXDEP), "Missing", "Available"),
    K9 = if_else(is.na(K9_nSBQ_ANXDEP), "Missing", "Available")
  ) %>%
  count(K7, K8, K9) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

int_missing_patterns
```

# Classification Sexual Orientation 

```{r}
# Classification Sexual orientation 
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    orientation_k7 = case_when(
      ADR_GenderChild == 1 & K7_5000 == 5 ~ "Heterosexual",
      ADR_GenderChild == 2 & K7_5000 == 1 ~ "Heterosexual",
      
      ADR_GenderChild == 1 & K7_5000 %in% 1:4 ~ "Non-heterosexual",
      ADR_GenderChild == 2 & K7_5000 %in% 2:5 ~ "Non-heterosexual",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    orientation_k8 = case_when(
      ADR_GenderChild == 1 & K8_5000 == 5 ~ "Heterosexual",
      ADR_GenderChild == 2 & K8_5000 == 1 ~ "Heterosexual",
      
      ADR_GenderChild == 1 & K8_5000 %in% 1:4 ~ "Non-heterosexual",
      ADR_GenderChild == 2 & K8_5000 %in% 2:5 ~ "Non-heterosexual",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    orientation_k9 = case_when(
      ADR_GenderChild == 1 & K9_5000 == 5 ~ "Heterosexual",
      ADR_GenderChild == 2 & K9_5000 == 1 ~ "Heterosexual",
      
      ADR_GenderChild == 1 & K9_5000 %in% 1:4 ~ "Non-heterosexual",
      ADR_GenderChild == 2 & K9_5000 %in% 2:5 ~ "Non-heterosexual",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


# define reference group
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    orientation_k7 = factor(
      orientation_k7,
      levels = c("Heterosexual", "Non-heterosexual")
    ),
    orientation_k8 = factor(
      orientation_k8,
      levels = c("Heterosexual", "Non-heterosexual")
    ),
    orientation_k9 = factor(
      orientation_k9,
      levels = c("Heterosexual", "Non-heterosexual")
    )
  )
```

# Attrition Analysis

```{r}
# subdataset for attrition Analysis
dat_selection <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    selection_status = if_else(
      !is.na(orientation_k9),
      "Included",
      "Excluded"
    )
  )

# compare different baseline characteristica -> do participants who weren't there anymore at K9 different at K7 from the people who stayed
selection_table <- dat_selection %>%
  group_by(selection_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),

    wb_k7 = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)",
                    mean(K7_Opti, na.rm = TRUE),
                    sd(K7_Opti, na.rm = TRUE)),

    int_k7 = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)",
                     mean(K7_nSBQ_ANXDEP, na.rm = TRUE),
                     sd(K7_nSBQ_ANXDEP, na.rm = TRUE)),

    peer_k7 = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)",
                      mean(K7_ResilFriends, na.rm = TRUE),
                      sd(K7_ResilFriends, na.rm = TRUE)),

    bullying_k7 = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)",
                          mean(K7_BullVict4, na.rm = TRUE),
                          sd(K7_BullVict4, na.rm = TRUE)),

    ses = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)",
                  mean(`K5#6_ISEImax`, na.rm = TRUE),
                  sd(`K5#6_ISEImax`, na.rm = TRUE)),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -selection_status,
    names_to = "Characteristic",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = selection_status,
    values_from = Value
  )

selection_table ### -> SES unterscheidet sich zwischen Excluded und Included
```

## Eligible Sample 

```{r}
# select eligible sample 
dat_eligible <- dat %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(K9_5000),
    !is.na(ADR_GenderChild),
    !is.na(`K5#6_ISEImax`)
  )
```

### Sexual Orientation

```{r}
# Missingness
table(dat_eligible$K7_5000, useNA = "ifany")
table(dat_eligible$K8_5000, useNA = "ifany")
table(dat_eligible$K9_5000, useNA = "ifany")

# pattern missingness over the course of the three waves
dat_eligible <- dat_eligible %>%
  mutate(
    sexor_pattern = case_when(
      !is.na(K7_5000) & !is.na(K8_5000) & !is.na(K9_5000) ~ "K7_K8_K9",
      !is.na(K7_5000) & !is.na(K8_5000) &  is.na(K9_5000) ~ "K7_K8",
      !is.na(K7_5000) &  is.na(K8_5000) & !is.na(K9_5000) ~ "K7_K9",
      !is.na(K7_5000) &  is.na(K8_5000) &  is.na(K9_5000) ~ "K7_only",
       is.na(K7_5000) & !is.na(K8_5000) & !is.na(K9_5000) ~ "K8_K9",
       is.na(K7_5000) & !is.na(K8_5000) &  is.na(K9_5000) ~ "K8_only",
       is.na(K7_5000) &  is.na(K8_5000) & !is.na(K9_5000) ~ "K9_only",
       is.na(K7_5000) &  is.na(K8_5000) &  is.na(K9_5000) ~ "none" 
    )
  )

table(dat$sexor_pattern)


#how many participants in each category 
table(dat_eligible$orientation_k7, useNA = "ifany")
table(dat_eligible$orientation_k8, useNA = "ifany")
table(dat_eligible$orientation_k9, useNA = "ifany")


# stability across the waves
table(dat_eligible$orientation_k7, dat$orientation_k8, useNA = "ifany")
table(dat_eligible$orientation_k8, dat$orientation_k9, useNA = "ifany")
table(dat_eligible$orientation_k7, dat$orientation_k9, useNA = "ifany")

## Who has changed classification over the course of three waves at least once? 
dat_eligible <- dat_eligible %>%
  mutate(
    orientation_change = case_when(
      
      # all three waves there and classification stayed identical
      !is.na(orientation_k7) &
      !is.na(orientation_k8) &
      !is.na(orientation_k9) &
      orientation_k7 == orientation_k8 &
      orientation_k8 == orientation_k9 ~ "No change",
      
      # all three waves there and classification changed
      !is.na(orientation_k7) &
      !is.na(orientation_k8) &
      !is.na(orientation_k9) ~ "Change",
      
      # not all three waves theren
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

table(dat_eligible$orientation_change, useNA = "ifany")


## rename
dat_eligible <- dat_eligible %>%
  mutate(
    attraction_k7 = factor(
      K7_5000,
      levels = 1:5,
      labels = c(
        "Only men",
        "Mainly men",
        "Men and women equally",
        "Mainly women",
        "Only women"
      )
    ),
    attraction_k8 = factor(
      K8_5000,
      levels = 1:5,
      labels = c(
        "Only men",
        "Mainly men",
        "Men and women equally",
        "Mainly women",
        "Only women"
      )
    ),
    attraction_k9 = factor(
      K9_5000,
      levels = 1:5,
      labels = c(
        "Only men",
        "Mainly men",
        "Men and women equally",
        "Mainly women",
        "Only women"
      )
    )
  )


# APPENDIX TABLE SEXUAL ORIENTATION

# 1. Number of classification changes -> hat nicht GEKLAPPT
tab_changes <- orientation_changes %>%
  filter(n_available == 3) %>%
  count(n_changes, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1),
    Category = case_when(
      n_changes == 0 ~ "No changes",
      n_changes == 1 ~ "One change",
      n_changes == 2 ~ "Two changes"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Category, n, percent)

# 2. Direction of a single change
tab_direction <- orientation_changes %>%
  filter(n_available == 3, n_changes == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = case_when(
      orientation_k7 == "Heterosexual" &
        orientation_k9 == "Non-heterosexual" ~
        "Heterosexual to SMY",

      orientation_k7 == "Non-heterosexual" &
        orientation_k9 == "Heterosexual" ~
        "SMY to heterosexual"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(Category, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)
  )

# 3. Combine both sections
table_data <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    Category = "Number of classification changes",
    n = NA_integer_,
    percent = NA_real_
  ),
  tab_changes,
  tibble(
    Category = "Direction of a single classification change",
    n = NA_integer_,
    percent = NA_real_
  ),
  tab_direction
) %>%
  mutate(
    n = ifelse(is.na(n), "", as.character(n)),
    percent = ifelse(
      is.na(percent), "",
      sprintf("%.1f", percent)
    )
  )

# 4. APA 7 formatting
ft <- flextable(table_data) %>%
  set_header_labels(
    Category = "Classification changes",
    n = "n",
    percent = "%"
  ) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  bold(i = c(1, 5), j = 1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") %>%
  align(j = 2:3, align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
  font(fontname = "Arial", part = "all") %>%
  padding(padding = 5, part = "all") %>%
  autofit()

# 5. Display table in RStudio
ft

# 6. Export as PNG
save_as_image(
  ft,
  path = "orientation_changes_APA.png"
)

```

### Well-Being

```{r}

summary(dat_eligible$K7_Opti)

summary(dat_eligible$K9_Opti)

# standard deviation 
sd(dat_eligible$K7_Opti, na.rm = TRUE)
sd(dat_eligible$K8_Opti, na.rm = TRUE)
sd(dat_eligible$K9_Opti, na.rm = TRUE)

# histograms
hist(dat_eligible$K7_Opti,
     main = "Well-being K7",
     xlab = "Well-being")

hist(dat_eligible$K8_Opti,

     xlab = "Well-being")

hist(dat_eligible$K9_Opti,

  dat_eligible %>% select(K7_21:K7_24)
)

)

## Wave 9

)

# Extract alpha coefficients
round(c(

), 2)


# missingness

mean(is.na(dat_eligible$K9_Opti)) * 100

dat_eligible <- dat_eligible %>%
  mutate(
    wb_k7_available = !is.na(K7_Opti),

table(dat_eligible$wb_k7_available)

table(dat_eligible$wb_k9_available)
```

### Peer Support

```{r}
# plausibility check
summary(dat_eligible$K7_ResilFriends)

# missingness
mean(is.na(dat_eligible$K7_ResilFriends)) * 100

summary(
  dat_eligible %>%
    select(K7_402, K7_404, K7_406)# 1st Qu. schon maximalwert -> gare keine Varianz?
)

# distribution of values
table(dat_eligible$K7_402, useNA = "ifany") 
table(dat_eligible$K7_404, useNA = "ifany")
table(dat_eligible$K7_406, useNA = "ifany")

# standard deviation 
sd(dat_eligible$K7_ResilFriends, na.rm = TRUE)

# histogram
hist(
  dat_eligible$K7_ResilFriends,
  main = "Peer Group Social Support K7",
  xlab = "Peer Group Social Support"
)

# cronbach's alpha
alpha_peer <- psych::alpha(
  dat_eligible %>%
    select(K7_402, K7_404, K7_406)
)

# Extract alpha coefficient
round(alpha_peer$total$raw_alpha, 2)

# grouped by orientation
dat_eligible %>%
  group_by(orientation_k9) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(K7_ResilFriends)),
    M = mean(K7_ResilFriends, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(K7_ResilFriends, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(K7_ResilFriends, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

dat_eligible %>%
  filter(!is.na(`K5#6_ISEImax`)) %>%
  mutate(
    support_gruppe = case_when(
      K7_ResilFriends < 2 ~ "Niedrig",
      K7_ResilFriends < 3 ~ "Mittel",
      K7_ResilFriends <= 4 ~ "Hoch",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  count(support_gruppe) %>%
  mutate(prozent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))

dat_eligible %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(`K5#6_ISEImax`),
    !is.na(K7_ResilFriends),
    !is.na(orientation_k9)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    support_gruppe = case_when(
      K7_ResilFriends < 2 ~ "Niedrig",
      K7_ResilFriends < 3 ~ "Mittel",
      K7_ResilFriends <= 4 ~ "Hoch"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(orientation_k9, support_gruppe) %>%
  group_by(orientation_k9) %>%
  mutate(prozent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Create consistent names

```{r}
dat_long <- dat_eligible %>%
  rename(
    K7_wellbeing = K7_Opti,
    K8_wellbeing = K8_Opti,
    K9_wellbeing = K9_Opti,

    K7_internalizing = K7_nSBQ_ANXDEP,
    K8_internalizing = K8_nSBQ_ANXDEP,
    K9_internalizing = K9_nSBQ_ANXDEP,

    K7_orientation = orientation_k7,
    K8_orientation = orientation_k8,
    K9_orientation = orientation_k9
  )
```

# pivot longer

```{r}
dat_long <- dat_long %>%
  dplyr::select(
    person_id,

    # Outcomes
    K7_wellbeing, K8_wellbeing, K9_wellbeing,
    K7_internalizing, K8_internalizing, K9_internalizing,

    # Sexual orientation
   # grouping variable 
    K9_orientation, K7_orientation, K8_orientation,

    # timeinvariant variables
    ADR_GenderChild,
    `K5#6_ISEImax`,

    # other predictors
    K7_ResilFriends,
    K7_BullVict4
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      K7_wellbeing, K8_wellbeing, K9_wellbeing,
      K7_internalizing, K8_internalizing, K9_internalizing
    ),
    names_to = c("wave", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(K[789])_(.*)"
  )
```

## Sample description

```{r}
# sample size

# Sexual Orientation
# 1. Calculate distribution by wave
tab1 <- dat_eligible %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(orientation_k7, orientation_k8, orientation_k9),
    names_to = "wave",
    values_to = "orientation"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    wave = toupper(sub("orientation_", "", wave)),
    orientation = as.character(orientation)
  ) %>%
  group_by(wave) %>%
  summarise(
    het = sum(orientation == "Heterosexual", na.rm = TRUE),
    non = sum(orientation == "Non-heterosexual", na.rm = TRUE),
    Missing = sum(is.na(orientation)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    valid = het + non,
    `Heterosexual, n (%)` =
      sprintf("%d (%.1f)", het, 100 * het / valid),
    `Non-heterosexual, n (%)` =
      sprintf("%d (%.1f)", non, 100 * non / valid)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Wave = wave,
    `Heterosexual, n (%)`,
    `Non-heterosexual, n (%)`,
    Missing
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(Wave, levels = c("K7", "K8", "K9")))

# 2. Format table
ft1 <- flextable(tab1) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  font(fontname = "Arial", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
  align(align = "left", part = "all") %>%
  autofit()

# 3. Display table in RStudio
ft1

# 4. Export as PNG
save_as_image(
  ft1,
  path = "sexual_orientation_distribution.png",
  res = 300
)

# 5. Export as editable Word table
save_as_docx(
  "Distribution of Sexual Orientation Across Assessment Waves" = ft1,
  path = "sexual_orientation_distribution.docx"
)


# 1. Prepare complete cases
plot_data <- dat_eligible %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(orientation_k7),
    !is.na(orientation_k8),
    !is.na(orientation_k9)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    K7 = as.character(orientation_k7),
    K8 = as.character(orientation_k8),
    K9 = as.character(orientation_k9)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    K7 %in% c("Heterosexual", "Non-heterosexual"),
    K8 %in% c("Heterosexual", "Non-heterosexual"),
    K9 %in% c("Heterosexual", "Non-heterosexual")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    trajectory = case_when(
      K7 == "Heterosexual" &
        K8 == "Heterosexual" &
        K9 == "Heterosexual" ~ "Stable heterosexual",

      K7 == "Non-heterosexual" &
        K8 == "Non-heterosexual" &
        K9 == "Non-heterosexual" ~ "Stable non-heterosexual",

      K7 == "Heterosexual" &
        K9 == "Non-heterosexual" ~ "Change to non-heterosexual",

      K7 == "Non-heterosexual" &
        K9 == "Heterosexual" ~ "Change to heterosexual",

      TRUE ~ "Multiple changes"
    ),
    trajectory = factor(
      trajectory,
      levels = c(
        "Stable heterosexual",
        "Stable non-heterosexual",
        "Change to non-heterosexual",
        "Change to heterosexual",
        "Multiple changes")))

# 2. Aggregate individual trajectories
flows <- plot_data %>%
  count(K7, K8, K9, trajectory, name = "n")

# 3. Prepare stratum labels
strata_labels <- plot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(K7, K8, K9),
    names_to = "wave",
    values_to = "orientation"
  ) %>%
  count(wave, orientation, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      ifelse(
        orientation == "Heterosexual",
        "Het.",
        "Non-het."
      ),
      "\n(n = ", n, ")"))

# 4. Color palette
flow_colors <- c(
  "Stable heterosexual" = "#E3E3E3",
  "Stable non-heterosexual" = "#467FA8",
  "Change to non-heterosexual" = "#79B9D9",
  "Change to heterosexual" = "#E8B45A",
  "Multiple changes" = "#C78EB4")

# 5. Alluvial plot
p_alluvial <- ggplot(
  flows,
  aes(
    axis1 = K7,
    axis2 = K8,
    axis3 = K9,
    y = n)) +
  geom_alluvium(
    aes(fill = trajectory),
    width = 0.16,
    alpha = 0.9,
    color = NA,
    decreasing = NA,
    reverse = FALSE,
    lode.guidance = "frontback"
  ) +
  geom_stratum(
    width = 0.16,
    fill = "#F5F5F5",
    color = "#666666",
    linewidth = 0.45,
    decreasing = NA,
    reverse = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(
      label = paste0(
        ifelse(
          after_stat(stratum) == "Heterosexual",
          "Het.",
          "Non-het."
        ),
        "\n(n = ", after_stat(count), ")"
      )
    ),
    size = 3.2,
    lineheight = 0.95,
    decreasing = NA,
    reverse = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("K7", "K8", "K9"),
    expand = c(0.12, 0.12)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = flow_colors,
    breaks = names(flow_colors),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Assessment wave",
    y = "Number of participants"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(1.1, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.25, "cm"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 2,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  )

print(p_alluvial)

# 6. Export png
ggsave(
  "alluvial_orientation.png",
  plot = p_alluvial,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

# What changes in N because of decisions taken regarding SMY-Classification 

```{r}
# RQ1 and RQ2: Compare K9-based and Ever-SMY classifications
# wide dataset before filtering K9 orientation
df_check <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    # Check whether K9 orientation data are available
    orientation_ok = !is.na(orientation_k9),

    # Identify participants classified as SMY at K9
    smy_K9 = orientation_k9 == "Non-heterosexual",

    # Identify participants reporting non-heterosexual attraction at K7 or K8
    ever_smy_earlier =
      (orientation_k7 %in% "Non-heterosexual") |
      (orientation_k8 %in% "Non-heterosexual"),

    # Identify participants classified as SMY under the Ever-SMY definition
    ever_smy = (smy_K9 %in% TRUE) | ever_smy_earlier,

    # Check availability of covariates
    covariates_ok =
      !is.na(ADR_GenderChild) &
      !is.na(`K5#6_ISEImax`),

    # H1a: Well-being
    H1a = covariates_ok &
      (!is.na(K7_Opti) |
       !is.na(K8_Opti) |
       !is.na(K9_Opti)),

    # H1b: Internalizing symptoms
    H1b = covariates_ok &
      (!is.na(K7_nSBQ_ANXDEP) |
       !is.na(K8_nSBQ_ANXDEP) |
       !is.na(K9_nSBQ_ANXDEP)),

    # H2a: Well-being
    H2a = covariates_ok &
      !is.na(K7_Opti) &
      !is.na(K9_Opti) &
      !is.na(K7_ResilFriends),

    # H2b: Internalizing symptoms
    H2b = covariates_ok &
      !is.na(K7_nSBQ_ANXDEP) &
      !is.na(K9_nSBQ_ANXDEP) &
      !is.na(K7_ResilFriends)
  )

# Create sensitivity analysis sample comparison table
sensitivity_table_rq1_rq2 <- df_check %>%
  # Include only participants with available K9 orientation data
  filter(orientation_ok) %>%
  select(
    H1a, H1b, H2a, H2b,
    smy_K9, ever_smy
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(H1a, H1b, H2a, H2b),
    names_to = "Hypothesis",
    values_to = "eligible"
  ) %>%
  filter(eligible %in% TRUE) %>%
  group_by(Hypothesis) %>%
  summarise(
    # Total number of eligible participants with K9 orientation data
    N_total = n(),

    # Number of participants classified as SMY at K9
    N_K9_SMY = sum(smy_K9 %in% TRUE),

    # Number of participants reclassified as SMY based on K7 or K8
    N_reclassified = sum(
      !(smy_K9 %in% TRUE) &
      (ever_smy %in% TRUE)
    ),

    # Total number of participants classified as Ever-SMY
    N_Ever_SMY = sum(ever_smy %in% TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

View(sensitivity_table_rq1_rq2)


# RQ3
# RQ 3: Compare sample sizes between K9-based and Ever-SMY classifications
h3_check <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    # Check whether K9 orientation data are available
    orientation_ok = !is.na(orientation_k9),

    # Identify participants classified as SMY at K9
    smy_K9 = orientation_k9 == "Non-heterosexual",

    # Identify participants reporting non-heterosexual attraction at K7 or K8
    ever_smy_earlier =
      (orientation_k7 %in% "Non-heterosexual") |
      (orientation_k8 %in% "Non-heterosexual"),

    # Identify participants classified as SMY under the Ever-SMY definition
    ever_smy = smy_K9 | ever_smy_earlier,

    # Check availability of covariates
    covariates_ok =
      !is.na(ADR_GenderChild) &
      !is.na(`K5#6_ISEImax`),

    # H3a: Complete-case eligibility for well-being
    H3a_eligible =
      !is.na(K7_Opti) &
      !is.na(K7_ResilFriends) &
      !is.na(K7_BullVict4) &
      covariates_ok,

    # H3b: Complete-case eligibility for internalizing symptoms
    H3b_eligible =
      !is.na(K7_nSBQ_ANXDEP) &
      !is.na(K7_ResilFriends) &
      !is.na(K7_BullVict4) &
      covariates_ok
  )

# Create sample comparison table
h3_table <- h3_check %>%
  filter(orientation_ok) %>%
  select(
    H3a_eligible,
    H3b_eligible,
    smy_K9,
    ever_smy
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_eligible"),
    names_to = "Hypothesis",
    values_to = "eligible"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Hypothesis) %>%
  summarise(
    # Number of eligible participants classified as SMY at K9
    N_K9_SMY = sum(
      eligible & (smy_K9 %in% TRUE)
    ),

    # Number of participants reclassified as SMY based on K7 or K8
    N_reclassified = sum(
      eligible &
      !(smy_K9 %in% TRUE) &
      (ever_smy %in% TRUE)
    ),

    # Total number of eligible participants under the Ever-SMY classification
    N_Ever_SMY = sum(
      eligible & (ever_smy %in% TRUE)
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

View(h3_table)  
```

```{r}
# RQ1–RQ3: Participants excluded due to missing K9 orientation data
# wide dataset BEFORE filtering K9 orientation
df_check <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    # Check whether K9 orientation data are available
    orientation_ok = !is.na(orientation_k9),

    # Check availability of covariates
    covariates_ok =
      !is.na(ADR_GenderChild) &
      !is.na(`K5#6_ISEImax`),

    # H1a: Well-being
    H1a = covariates_ok &
      (!is.na(K7_Opti) |
       !is.na(K8_Opti) |
       !is.na(K9_Opti)),

    # H1b: Internalizing symptoms
    H1b = covariates_ok &
      (!is.na(K7_nSBQ_ANXDEP) |
       !is.na(K8_nSBQ_ANXDEP) |
       !is.na(K9_nSBQ_ANXDEP)),

    # H2a: Well-being
    H2a = covariates_ok &
      !is.na(K7_Opti) &
      !is.na(K9_Opti) &
      !is.na(K7_ResilFriends),

    # H2b: Internalizing symptoms
    H2b = covariates_ok &
      !is.na(K7_nSBQ_ANXDEP) &
      !is.na(K9_nSBQ_ANXDEP) &
      !is.na(K7_ResilFriends)
  )

# Create exclusion table
exclusion_table <- df_check %>%
  select(
    H1a, H1b, H2a, H2b,
    orientation_ok
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(H1a, H1b, H2a, H2b),
    names_to = "Hypothesis",
    values_to = "eligible"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Hypothesis) %>%
  summarise(
    # Participants meeting all criteria except K9 orientation
    N_eligible = sum(eligible, na.rm = TRUE),

    # Participants excluded solely due to missing K9 orientation
    N_excluded_K9 = sum(
      eligible & !orientation_ok,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    # Participants remaining after applying K9 orientation criterion
    N_with_K9 = sum(
      eligible & orientation_ok,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

View(exclusion_table)

# RQ3: Check exclusions due to missing K9 orientation data
# Only participants identified as SMY are considered

h3_check <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    # Check availability of K9 orientation data
    orientation_ok = !is.na(orientation_k9),

    # Identify participants classified as SMY at K9
    smy_K9 = orientation_k9 %in% "Non-heterosexual",

    # Identify potential SMY based on K7 or K8
    smy_earlier =
      (orientation_k7 %in% "Non-heterosexual") |
      (orientation_k8 %in% "Non-heterosexual"),

    # Check availability of covariates
    covariates_ok =
      !is.na(ADR_GenderChild) &
      !is.na(`K5#6_ISEImax`),

    # H3a: Well-being
    H3a = covariates_ok &
      !is.na(K7_Opti) &
      !is.na(K7_ResilFriends) &
      !is.na(K7_BullVict4),

    # H3b: Internalizing symptoms
    H3b = covariates_ok &
      !is.na(K7_nSBQ_ANXDEP) &
      !is.na(K7_ResilFriends) &
      !is.na(K7_BullVict4)
  )

# Create exclusion table for RQ3
h3_exclusion_table <- h3_check %>%
  select(
    H3a, H3b,
    orientation_ok,
    smy_K9,
    smy_earlier
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(H3a, H3b),
    names_to = "Hypothesis",
    values_to = "eligible"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Hypothesis) %>%
  summarise(
    # SMY included based on K9 classification
    N_included = sum(
      eligible & smy_K9,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    # Potential SMY excluded due to missing K9 orientation
    N_excluded_K9 = sum(
      eligible &
      !orientation_ok &
      smy_earlier,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    # Total number of identifiable SMY
    N_potential_total = N_included + N_excluded_K9,

    .groups = "drop"
  )

View(h3_exclusion_table)
```
